transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I've been having a really hard time staying seated lately, especially during meetings at work or when I'm out at restaurants. I just feel this constant need to get up and move around when I'm supposed to be sitting still.
Do you also have difficulty paying attention to details, following instructions, or completing tasks, or is it mainly the restlessness and need to move that's been bothering you?

It's definitely the restlessness and the constant need to move that's the main issue, and I also really struggle with waiting my turn. I don't really have trouble paying attention to details, following instructions, or finishing my tasks.
I'm sorry, I think I missed what you just asked. Could you please repeat that for me?
How long have you been experiencing this restlessness and difficulty waiting your turn, has it been a persistent issue throughout your life or did it start recently?

It's been really persistent and constant for about a year and four months now. However, these types of issues actually first started when I was a kid, definitely before the age of 12. It just seems to have become much harder to manage recently.

Even though you mentioned earlier that you don't have trouble paying attention to details or following instructions, can you think of any situations where you might struggle with organization, time management, or avoiding distractions?
No, I don't really struggle with those things at all. Organization and time management have never really been an issue for me, and I don't easily get distracted either.
Can you tell me more about your impulsivity, such as interrupting others, blurting out answers, or intruding on conversations, and how often this happens in your daily life?

I don't really struggle with interrupting others, blurting out answers, or intruding on conversations. That's not something I've noticed happening in my daily life. I'm usually able to hold back, even if waiting my turn is difficult for me internally.
Can you estimate how often you feel the need to get up and move around when you're supposed to be sitting still, is it happening multiple times a day or is it more sporadic?

It happens very frequently, definitely multiple times a day. I feel this constant, intense internal restlessness that makes me feel like I absolutely have to get up and move around whenever I'm expected to sit still.
How have these symptoms been affecting your daily life, such as your work, relationships, or social interactions, and have you noticed any significant impacts or challenges as a result?
I haven't really thought about how these behaviors impact my work, relationships, or social life specifically. I'm not quite sure how to describe the impact they have on those areas of my life.

This conversation has reached its end. The patient's symptoms and history are consistent with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation). Further questions may not yield additional diagnostic clarity. A diagnosis and treatment plan can now be considered.
Thank you for your assessment, doctor; it's a relief to have some clarity on what has been going on. What would you recommend as the next steps or treatment plan for managing this?
